title: CAUSTIC REFRACTION IV
camera: Hasselblad 500C/M · Planar 80mm f/2.8 · Ilford HP5 Plus pushed +2
caption: Light bent through industrial fluted glass at 02:00 AM under sodium-vapor streetlamps. Developing at +2 stops fractured the midtones into metallic silver clusters.

title: BRUTALIST CANTILEVER IN FOG
camera: Leica M6 TTL · Summilux 35mm f/1.4 · Kodak Tri-X 400
caption: Concrete geometry dissolving into coastal advection fog. Exposed for the specular edge so the underside drops into pure D-max black.

title: SOLARIZED FERROFLUID HARMONICS
camera: Pentax 67II · Macro Takumar 135mm f/4 · Rollei Ortho 25
caption: Magnetic standing waves excited by a 48Hz sine wave and briefly flashed with amber safelight mid-development to trigger the Sabattier edge reversal.

title: ANALOG OSCILLOSCOPE LISSAJOUS
camera: Nikon F3HP · Noct-Nikkor 58mm f/1.2 · CineStill Double-X
caption: Phosphor persistence captured directly off a 1978 Tektronix CRT driven by a custom WebAudio modular synthesizer patch.

title: SILVER HALIDE DRIFT // CHEMIGRAM
camera: Camera-less Darkroom Chemigram · Ilford Multigrade Fiber Warmtone
caption: Direct chemical painting on fiber-based silver gelatin paper. Resist layers of beeswax and developer etched organic topography without a lens.

title: SODIUM VAPOR TRANSIT
caption: Long-exposure halation bleed from an elevated rail line cutting through rain-slicked asphalt at midnight.
